// Klauss CPU test suite
// Run with: klausscc -L all_tests.txt -s

// Register and arithmetic
test_regs.kla
test_arithmetic.kla
test_logic.kla
test_shifts.kla
test_bits.kla
test_muldiv.kla
test_three_operand.kla

// Comparison and flow control
test_compare_jump.kla
test_call_ret.kla
test_loop_patterns.kla

// Memory
test_memory.kla
test_stack.kla
test_indexed_mem.kla

// Data types and extensions
test_sign_extend.kla
test_strings.kla
test_txstr.kla
test_edge_cases.kla

// I/O
test_io.kla

// Aggressive / stress tests
test_boundary.kla
test_rotate.kla
test_compare_ext.kla
test_algorithms.kla
test_benchmark.kla

// Directives and compiled C (test_64bit brings in ../../runtime/crt0.kla)
test_directives.kla
hello_world.kla
test_64bit.kla

// Emulator-vs-hardware check: every behaviour the emulator was aligned
// with the RTL (flags, divide by zero, unaligned 64-bit, BEXTR/BDEP, .S imm8,
// strings, inline data)
hw_alignment.kla

// RTL squash fixes in klaussCPU 9ad6614: a divide squashed by a taken fused
// branch, and a busy divide during a self-modifying-code squash
hw_div_fbr.kla
hw_div_smc.kla

// The hw-proposals instructions (klaussCPU master 3508f87): W and imm32
// fused branches, CMPRVW.S, MULV.S/MULUV.S/MULUV, LEAPC.S, DI/EI
hw_proposals.kla

// MMU stage 1 (klaussCPU branch mmu): exceptions to EVEC, user mode,
// SYSCALL, MFSR/MTSR, LR/SC.  Needs a bitstream whose CPU_FEATURES
// (0xF00F_0048) reads 0x9; on an older one it parks at its first MTSR.
hw_mmu.kla

// hw_mpu.kla (the MPU) is not listed: the MPU is off in the Nexys A7
// bitstream (klaussCPU MMU_PLAN §10).  Run it by hand on an MPU build.

// MMU stage 3 (klaussCPU branch mmu, release 98fe470): the TLB.  Needs
// CPU_FEATURES bit 2; on an older bitstream it mismatches at a1.
hw_tlb.kla
